freeze_rule: This file is the round-32 freeze: the first commit that adds it is the freeze commit. Counters, predicates, labels, targets, the 12-carrier list, the 12 predictions, the C2 key list and fleet pin are fixed from that commit; a miss under them is reported, never amended, never re-scaled. Control receipts are committed before the data commit.
lowest_axis: At the base the three owned axes (coverage, depth, calibration) are tied at 10 with none retired (SCORECARD.md:23-25 and :155 at 283aad7f); on a tie every owned axis is a lowest axis, so C1 (coverage) and C2 (calibration) both work a lowest-scoring non-retired axis.

Round 32 leaves that shape: C1 moves a PROVINCE Frontier reserve edge class (ARM64X hybrid PE, PROVINCE.md:83 under ## Frontier :73) into Core with no refusal table; C2 is calibration of the lane's own repertoire table against the outside closure record.
